section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section summarizes the findings of a single study, which explored the impact of affect regulation strategies, specifically self-compassionate engagement, self-compassionate action, and psychological flexibility, on body appreciation in adult women. The study found that psychological inflexibility mediates the association between self-compassionate engagement and action, and that self-compassionate action and psychological inflexibility directly predict body appreciation. The authors also acknowledge several limitations, including the cross-sectional design and the sample being composed solely of women.

section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section focuses on the shift in body image research towards body appreciation and explores the impact of affect regulation strategies on positive body image variables. The present study, which involved adult women, investigated the roles of self-compassionate engagement, self-compassionate action, and psychological flexibility in predicting body appreciation. It utilized a path analysis model and discussed methodological limitations, including the cross-sectional design and the exclusive focus on women in the sample.
